question: Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair, born in Kerala, was a ________ dancer
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair**, also famous as Guru Chemancheri was an **Indian Kathakali actor**.
 
• He spent eighty years learning, teaching,** and representing Kathakali, a necessary** form of classical Indian dance.
 
• Kathakali
